subtitles.en: Bahá'u'lláh's Arabic and Persian aphorisms — the Bahá'í pilot of the Translation Program

descriptions.en: **Planned** Wheel of Heaven Translation of Bahá'u'lláh's Hidden Words (Kalimát-i-Maknúnih, c. 1858) from the Arabic and Persian originals. Part I: 71 Arabic aphorisms; Part II: 82 Persian aphorisms. Dual-language pilot — the pipeline's first Persian work. Independent of and unaffiliated with the authorised Bahá'í World Centre translations.
